title: Vietnamese-Style Boiled Cheese Kho
description: A unique fusion dish combining the flavors of Vietnam with the comfort of cheese. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cut the boiled kho into bite-sized pieces.
In a large saucepan, heat the ca kho sauce over medium heat.
Add the zesty cheese and stir until melted and well combined with the sauce.
Add the boiled kho and stir to coat with the cheese sauce.
Add the to and stir to combine.
Optional: Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
Note: This recipe is vegetarian-friendly, but you can also use chicken or pork for added protein.
Adjust the amount of ca kho sauce to your taste.
If using chicken or pork, add it to the saucepan with the cheese and stir until cooked through.
